# Monocypher

A small cryptography library, used by AirPlay output for ChaCha20-Poly1305,
X25519 and Ed25519.

`monocypher.c` and `monocypher.h`, and `monocypher-ed25519.c` and
`monocypher-ed25519.h` from its `src/optional`, are copied unmodified from
Monocypher 4.0.2:
https://monocypher.org/download/monocypher-4.0.2.tar.gz
(SHA-256 38d07179738c0c90677dba3ceb7a7b8496bcfea758ba1a53e803fed30ae0879c)

`LICENCE.md` is Monocypher's, from the same release: BSD-2-Clause or CC0.
